description: SEC 10-K market-risk sensitivities (Item 7A) — Market-risk exposure from a US public company's latest (or earlier, filing 0-4) Form 10-K on SEC EDGAR (Item 7A Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk). Returns the quantified sensitivities the company discloses - each with risk type (interestRate / foreignCurrency / commodity / equityPrice / credit), the shock (e.g. 100 bps, 10%), the dollar impact (table figures in millions are scaled and flagged) and the quoted sentence or table row - plus the largest sensitivity, primary risk, value-at-risk figures, hedging instruments named (swaps, forwards, collars, hedge types), any no-speculation statement, coverage per risk type, and a depth tier DETAILED / STANDARD / MINIMAL / CROSS_REFERENCED. When Item 7A only points elsewhere (common for banks), sensitivity sentences are gathered from the whole 10-K and flagged. Params: ticker (e.g. KO, or a CIK number); optional filing=0..4 for earlier 10-Ks. Source: SEC EDGAR (public domain). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_market_risk
